_comment: EXAMPLE universe configuration. This file is a template and is NEVER
loaded automatically. Copy it to config/universes.local.json (gitignored)
and edit that copy; until you do, the scanner has no configured universe.
as_of records when the membership list was captured. A list captured today
and scanned across years of history is survivorship-biased: companies that
left the list are absent. The scanner shows as_of beside the name so that
source_kind is your own attribution, not a verification. This system cannot
check index membership, so there is no source_kind claiming it does.
At most 50 universes, at most 100 symbols each. 100 is a hard safety
ceiling, NOT a performance recommendation: only small universes have been
measured, so start small and increase deliberately.

universes.source_reference: Illustrative research-demo membership: ten widely traded US symbols chosen to demonstrate the scanner. Not an index, and not guaranteed to be current or complete.
